fields.description: The site's name on Pilot: suite- and eight hex digits under the server's wildcard zone, e.g. suite-3f9a1c2b.blr1.frappe.cloud.
fields.label: Hostname

fields.description: Region the site is created in. Signups use the Default Region in Suite Cloud Settings.
fields.label: Region

fields.description: Chosen when the site is created: the server of the region with most free slots.
fields.label: Server

fields.description: Pending: waiting for a server with room. Creating: Pilot is creating it. Ready: in the pool, unclaimed. Assigned and Configuring: being connected to its tenant. Active: in use. Failed: stopped on an error; run Retry. Dropped: deleted from its server.
fields.label: Status
fields.options:
Pending
Creating
Ready
Assigned
Configuring
Active
Failed
Dropped

fields.description: Empty while the site waits in the pool.
fields.label: Tenant

fields.description: The tenant's label. acme gives the site domain acme.sites.example.com and the mail domain acme.example.com, under the zones set in Suite Cloud Settings.
fields.label: Label

fields.description: The domain the site is served under once it is attached, e.g. acme.sites.example.com. Blank until then: the hostname serves the site.
fields.label: Primary Domain

fields.description: Pilot has created the site with the Suite app on its server.
fields.label: Site Created

fields.description: The site was given its Suite Cloud URL, tenant id and secret, finished onboarding and reached Suite Cloud with them. Cleared to configure the site again, e.g. after a secret could not be pushed.
fields.label: Suite Configured

fields.description: The Mail Account Request on the site inviting the tenant's owner, e.g. for john@acme.example.com. They choose their password when they accept it.
fields.label: Owner Invite

fields.description: When the invite was last sent. It stays valid for 7 days; Resend Owner Invite sends it again, or a fresh one once it expired.
fields.label: Owner Invited At

fields.description: The Pilot task creating or dropping the site, while it runs.
fields.label: Pilot Task

fields.description: Hostnames tried; one is taken by another server now and then.
fields.label: Attempts

fields.description: When the site turned Active: connected to its tenant, with the tenant's user.
fields.label: Activated At

fields.description: When Drop Site deleted the site from its server.
fields.label: Dropped At

fields.description: Why the site failed, what it waits for, or why a step was skipped. A failed site stops until Retry; an Active site stays Active.
fields.label: Error

fields.description: Give the site its label under the site DNS zone, e.g. acme.sites.example.com, as its primary domain once it is active. Fixed once the domain is added: the site may already be reached under it.
fields.label: Assign Site Domain

fields.description: Domains the site is served under. Managed rows are published by Suite Cloud; the others are the tenant's to publish. Change them with the Domains actions.
fields.label: Domains

fields.description: The tenant's hosted mail domain, e.g. acme.example.com. Suite Cloud publishes its records and keeps the tenant API from changing it.
fields.label: Mail Domain

fields.description: The mailbox the site sends its own mail from, e.g. notification@acme.example.com. Its password lives only in the site's Email Account.
fields.label: Notification Account

fields.description: The site sends through the notification account by default.
fields.label: Email Account Created
